verdict.rationale: Data export with open formats is a fair question for an LLM observability and evaluation platform, but the evidence pack never documents any export or bulk-download feature. The OTel material covers only importing traces into Weave. The REST Service API and MCP server read access are developer building blocks someone could use to construct an export, not a documented export-and-leave capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
